 Latest news Find out this month’s benefits payment calendar for the Social Security and Supplemental Security Income programs.
 Getty Images U.S. benefits When do Social Security and SSI benefits go out in November 2026? Complete payment schedule
 William Allen Greg Heilman Update: Nov 13th, 2026 04:05 EST Share Make us preferred on Google As November 2026 approaches its midway point, the U.S.’s Social Security Administration (SSA) has completed three out of five payment dates for this month , as it sends out benefits for the following programs:
 Social Security (retirement, disability and survivor) 
 Supplemental Security Income (SSI) 
 Nov. 2026’s three-Wednesdays payment cycle: status update
 Of the 71.7 million Americans who receive Social Security benefits, most are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each month . These beneficiaries’ designated Wednesday is determined by their date of birth.
 So far this month, the SSA has sent out one batch of birthday-dependent payments - after November’s three-Wednesdays cycle began with a calendar quirk . Because the Veterans Day holiday fell on the month’s second Wednesday, the first of these three distribution dates was pushed forward by 24 hours.
 November 2026’s full three-Wednesdays cycle is: 
 Born on 1st-10th of any month: Social Security paid on Tuesday, Nov. 10 
 Born on 11th-20th of any month: Social Security paid on Wednesday, Nov. 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of any month: Social Security paid on Wednesday, Nov. 25 
 NB: If you get Social Security benefits based on someone else’s work record, the SSA uses the other person’s birthday to determine your payment Wednesday.
 What other benefits-payment dates are there in Nov. 2026?
 Oct. 30: SSI beneficiaries 
 Beneficiaries of the SSI scheme were paid for November slightly before this month arrived: on Friday, October 30 . 
 A benefit for low-income Americans who are over 65 or have a disability, SSI is typically distributed on the first day of each month. However, November’s benefit was issued ahead of schedule , as the month began on a weekend day .
 A scheme with nearly 7.3 million recipients nationwide, SSI provides an average monthly benefit of $740.07 , according to the SSA’s latest statistics. 
 Although SSI is operated by the SSA, it is separate to the Social Security program . Unlike Social Security, eligibility is not dependent on a claimant’s employment history.
 Nov. 3: Double beneficiaries/some long-term Social Security recipients 
 On Tuesday, November 3 , the SSA paid out this month’s Social Security money to beneficiaries who have been receiving their checks since before May 1997 . 
 Tuesday 3 was also November’s Social Security payment date for beneficiaries who simultaneously claim SSI .
 How much are Social Security benefits per month?
 Retirement: $2,037.84 
 Disability: $1,500.84 
 Survivor: $1,636.75 
 ( Average monthly Social Security benefit , per statistics shared by the SSA in November 2026.)
 Benefits to go up in 2027
 In October, the SSA announced that Social Security and SSI benefits are to increase in 2027 , as part of the agency’s annual cost-of-living adjustment (COLA). Starting with January’s payments, benefits recipients are to see a 3.6% rise in their monthly check.
 How does the Social Security Admin make benefits payments?
 Money can be paid into a Social Security or SSI beneficiary’s bank account by direct deposit 
 Benefits can be loaded onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for federal payments
